contexts.text: They are so delighted to punish, that they do not want to desist, even if it were to eternity.
Afterwards, he is not able to desist from these evils. DP 112:3.
They never desist, except through grievous punishments...
This sign signifies the first admonition with those who are infesting, that they should desist.

It is impossible for man to be saved, unless he who is in evil is allowed to do evil and to desist from evil: when he desists from evil of himself in this freedom, the affection of good and truth is insinuated by the Lord...
All good flows in from the Lord, and they love who desist from evil...
This is effected by the Lord when man desists from evils.
The man sees that they are evils, and therefore is able to desist from them, but will not, and therefore confirms them with himself...
Sins are not remitted, unless the man... desists from evils...
This influx is so far operative with man in proportion as he desists from evils...
This (conjunction with the Lord) takes place when man desists from evils; for to desist from evils is left to the determination or freedom of man... AC 10067:8.
Every man... is in the capacity of understanding Divine truth, and thence in the capacity of receiving, in proportion as he desists from evils.
The Lord removes the Hells, in proportion as man desists from evils.
Purification from evils and falsities is to desist from them...
When he desists the door is opened, and then the concupiscences of evil are cast out by the Lord...
When the man desists (from these evils), there arises a combat of the internal man with the external.
When man goes further, and wills to desist from evils, he is in the second step of reformation, and is then out of Hell, but not yet in Heaven...
A thief feels such delight in thefts that he cannot desist...
God cannot remit sins according to His laws, except in proportion as man desists from them according to His laws.
Man is an organ recipient of life from God, consequently is a recipient of good, in proportion as he desists from evil: the ability to desist from evil the Lord gives to every man...
They also perform repentance, who do not examine themselves, but still desist from evils because they are sins. General article.
Sins are... removed as man afterwards desists from them, and enters on a new life.
Evil Spirits never desist...
They were warned by others to desist, but confessed that they were not able...
Under Able, see this reference, and at SE 4020.
Their nature is such that they can never desist...
That evil Spirits cannot desist from attacking the good.
He said that he could never desist...
They never desist from a purpose once taken...
That a Spirit cannot desist from doing what his love leads.
If he is not able to desist...

III. When a man begins to think... that he should desist from doing evils, because they are sins... But in order to desist from them... he must supplicate the Lord for aid. The sins from which he must desist. Enumerated.

In proportion as a man thinks that he will shun evils, because they are sins, and supplicates the Lord for aid, the Lord removes them, and gives the man to desist from them as of himself, and afterwards to shun them.

It follows that man cannot at all desist from evils of himself; for this would be of his own life to desist from his own life; wherefore it is provided that he may be able to desist from them from the Lord. Explained.

The interior of man is no otherwise purified, than as he desists from evils according to the precepts of the Decalogue: in proportion as he has not desisted from these evils... they make his interior...
When the interior of man is purified from evils, by his desisting from them... the internal which is above it is opened...
